what.text: This page follows refugees from Serbia and Kosovo living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5287 refugees from Serbia and Kosovo in Germany, 17.8% of all refugees from Serbia and Kosovo.
France hosts the most refugees from Serbia and Kosovo, followed by Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kosovo territory in Serbia with the UCK in 1998 and 1999, at war level in both years.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at its highest figure, 183170 refugees.
It has fallen since then; the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005 and 2007 to 2012.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
